semantics.admission: ScalarS1 U8/U16/F32 only. Canonical unsigned integer values and representable widened finite binary32 required throughout the acquired plane, including outside area membership. PreserveQuietNaNFloat32 admits only its exact reviewed quietNaN encoding policy; exclude/report them. Refuse infinities, signaling/noncanonical NaNs, bad extents/storage/types/policies. F64/S3/S4 remain explicit first-consumer gaps; old Image/manual-threshold APIs unchanged.
semantics.area: rectangle,ellipse,rotated_rectangle,rotated_ellipse,polygon,freehand,mask use existing Selection validation/rasterization and preserve holes. Explicit packed empty mask is valid and yields zero area counts. Service refuses line/polyline/angle/point/multipoint/unknown; later Auto adapter separately maps valid nonarea selection to whole plane while retaining Selection dependency.
semantics.counts: visited_count=finite_count+nan_count over area membership. finite_count=included_count+underflow_count+overflow_count. included_count=sum(histogram.counts). Plane extrema/counts span the same one acquired XY source and support Auto fallback without a second acquisition; they do not alter area extrema/counts.
semantics.processor_raw: Require bins256 and absent explicit range. U8 edges0..256,origin0,width1. U16 edges from area min through max+1, bin_size=(max-min+1)/256; freeze scale=1/bin_size then index=int(scale*(v-int(min))), clamp last255. F32 bin_size=(max-min)/256; freeze scale=256/(max-min) then index=int(scale*(v-min)), clamp255 at upper endpoint. Do not reassociate the source-derived arithmetic. Constant F32 uses bin0, width0 and every edge equal the exact constant. No under/overflow.
semantics.no_finite: Owned finite presentation edges0..1,origin0,width1/256 for no-finite ProcessorRaw; zero counts, empty_finite=true and absent area extrema. This intentionally replaces Java sentinel/nonfinite presentation. Later Auto MUST refuse empty/no-finite area without publication/cycle advance; never silently Reset to whole plane.
semantics.uniform_range: Exact bins1..65536; finite low<high; final upper endpoint inclusive. Values below/above are separately counted; min/max retain all finite area values. Use overflow-safe normalization and finite monotonic edges, including finite bounds crossing double extremes. bin_size is the finite positive rounded width when representable; otherwise null for UniformRange overflow or underflow (e.g. bins1 across +/-DBL_MAX); never infinity, spurious zero or a clamped false width. ProcessorRaw bin_size is always present. Collapsed rounded UniformRange edges are allowed if finite and nondecreasing; explicit endpoint bin membership remains deterministic.
semantics.immutability: Capture Dataset handle, full request/selection, positive limits and ExecutionControl by value before the first user callback. Reentrant callbacks may mutate original caller variables, never effective work. Preserve source/calibration/attributes/sample bits and document state. Return only detached counts/edges/provenance/extrema.
semantics.resources: Estimator is descriptor/geometry/metadata only: no plane/provider sample reads, mask allocations or user callbacks. Validate malformed fields, checked arithmetic and positive caps before work. Include returned arrays, request/selection/attributes/packed retention, polygon raster scratch, full-canvas double mask when needed and one conservative XY double source/fallback plane. Exclude allocator bookkeeping, pre-existing source/cache/history/GPU/processRSS. Charge actual captured calibration unit/time-unit strings. All estimate fields are checked and working_bytes is the conservative simultaneous peak.
semantics.execution: Pre-cancellation and estimate/cap refusal precede all callbacks/plane reads. One Dataset.plane acquisition at the exact captured TCZ; retain it across validation/extrema and histogram passes. Use existing bounded kernel checkpoints for validation/mask/scans/bin filling. Callback exceptions/mid-cancel discard detached work. Never scan unrelated T/C/Z or materialize a volume.
